_comment: Reference tables imported into the reader's SQLite database (rw_dir/meridian.db). Each import replaces the table and keeps the source's own column names. 'table' is the SQLite table name.

datasets.label: Items
datasets.description: Item master: one row per item (part number, description, category, …).

datasets.label: Bins
datasets.description: Storage locations: crib, bin and the item stocked there.

datasets.label: Serial IDs
datasets.description: Serialized items: one row per individual tool, linked to its item.

datasets.label: RFID
datasets.description: RFID tag assignments: EPC to serial ID or item.
